source.citation: Wyffels SA et al. (2020). PLOS ONE 15(10): e0240629.
source.dataAvailability: All relevant data are within the manuscript and Supporting Information files.
source.license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), as stated on the PLOS article page.

audit.studyPopulation: Commercial herd of Angus and Angus x Simmental bred cows, ages 1-12, grazing one 329-ha Montana pasture in two dormant seasons; the study reports 272 cows in year 1 and 302 in year 2.
audit.collaredSample: The methods report five GPS-collared animals in each of six age classes. The selected S1/S2 files contain 29 distinct CowID values per year (58 across the two years).

S3.description: Cow unshrunk weight and body condition by age class for each grazing year; not repeated individual-level weight series.

preWtUnitReconciliation.method: Deduplicate by Year and CowID, average the 58 distinct cow-year PreWt values in S1, then compare conversions with the article's stated 627 kg average weight across both years.
preWtUnitReconciliation.conclusion: Strongly consistent with PreWt being pounds, based on reconciliation to the published 627 kg article mean; the unit is inferred, not explicitly labeled in the CSV.
preWtUnitReconciliation.confidence: High for unit reconciliation; the source metadata itself remains unlabeled.
preWtUnitReconciliation.handling: Preserve original CSV values and do not convert them in source files. Any derived use must record the inferred-pound conversion and its provenance.

limitations: No individual ADG or repeated individual weights in the selected daily CSVs; S3 reports class-level summaries.
PreWt unit is not declared in the CSV header; its pound interpretation is inferred from agreement with the published mean weight, not directly labeled by the source.
SuppInt is supplement intake, not total dry matter intake or forage intake.
Observational associations do not identify causal effects of supplementation or grazing management.
One pasture and two winters in Montana do not establish transportability to the USDA/CPER cohort or Brazilian systems.
audit.intendedUse: Separate read-only exploratory source for observed adult-cow grazing behavior; not engine validation, calibration, or the principal ADG/pasture case.
